# The IMAP Received fallback uses the message-state parser

The reduced IMAP fetch list supplies Received to the existing folder parser. SetupHeaderParseStream instantiates the contract registered as nsParseMailMessageState; that parser reads the final semicolon date from Received, stores dateReceived in seconds and can fill a missing message date. It can still fall back to the current time when no usable date remains. This supplies the concrete consumer behind provisional lesson b36d80967a90ea6c50fb62f8a3155075f7898d360241710328ddd65a155beaf7 and narrows any claim that missing Received leaves no usable date. This change adds no INTERNALDATE fallback and does not establish a performance result.

Scope: IMAP reduced header fetch and nsParseMailMessageState.
